北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气重，体感 -2℃。注意交通安全，添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy and feels like -2℃. Drive safely and dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有阵雨，地面湿滑。记得带伞，小心慢行哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has showers, roads are wet. Remember your umbrella and walk carefully!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，湿度 84%。出门注意保暖，保持好心情！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy with 84% humidity. Stay warm and keep a good mood!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云暖和，早晚温差大。注意适时增减衣物。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm, but big temperature difference. Adjust your clothes.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感舒适。但也要注意多喝水，保持活力哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and comfortable. Remember to drink water and stay energetic!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天微凉，体感 11℃。多穿点，别着凉了！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and cool, feels like 11℃. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 8℃。风力不小，记得防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and cool, feels like 8℃. It's windy, remember to stay warm and protected.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 39% 稍低。注意补水，保持肌肤水润。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with 39% humidity. Remember to hydrate and keep your skin moisturized.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 11℃。风力有点大，出门记得多穿点。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and cool, feels like 11℃. It's a bit windy, remember to dress warmly when going out.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云干燥。多喝水，滋润身体，注意保湿。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and dry. Drink more water, moisturize, and stay hydrated.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，风力 2 级不小。出门添件薄外套，保持舒适。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and windy with 2 level wind. Bring a light jacket to stay comfortable.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴冷，体感 -13℃。务必做好防寒保暖措施！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is clear but extremely cold, feels like -13℃. Be sure to take full cold protection measures!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感 -6℃。注意防寒，戴好帽子手套哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and cold, feels like -6℃. Stay warm, wear your hat and gloves!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，风力 3 级较大。早晚温差大，别忘了及时加衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and windy with 3 level wind. Large temperature difference, don't forget to add clothes.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感舒适。但也要注意多喝水，保持活力哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and comfortable. Remember to drink water and stay energetic!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，湿度 81% 较高。出门多穿点，注意防潮保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and cold with 81% humidity. Dress warmly and stay dry!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴冷，体感 -2℃ 冻人。风力不小，帽子围巾别落下！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and freezing cold, feels like -2℃. It's windy, don't forget your hat and scarf!
